artworks.title: Anticipated Effects of the Tailors' "Strike"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a satirical scene depicting men's fashion during a hypothetical tailors' strike. The illustration portrays men dressed in extravagant and outdated garments, with some outfits exaggerated to humorous proportions. In the background, there is a statue surrounded by trees and clouds. The drawing is filled with figures adorned in historical or comically enhanced clothing, featuring ruffs, cloaks, and oversized accessories. The setting seems to be in a park or garden. The text at the top of the drawing reads "Anticipated Effects of the Tailor's 'Strike' - or Gentlemens Fashions for - 1834".

artworks.title: John Flaxman
artworks.artist: William Daniell after George Dance II
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustrated profile portrait of a man, showing his upper body and head. He is seated in a chair, facing to the left side of the image. His facial features include a pronounced nose and a sharp jawline. He has receding, curly dark hair covering the sides and back of his head. He wears a high-collared shirt with a jacket over it, featuring vertical lines and buttons. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Prince Hoare
artworks.artist: William Daniell after George Dance II
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man in profile, seated or standing with an upright posture. He has a prominent nose, a slightly high forehead, short curly hair, and wears a formal coat with wide lapels over a high-collared shirt with ruffles. The background is plain and light with no additional details.

artworks.title: A qui le tour?
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a soldier standing among historical artifacts. The soldier holds a flag and stands in front of several sacks labeled with different years, including "1870", "1848", "1830", and "1815". The background wall is inscribed with "MUSEE DES SOUVERAINS". The soldier appears confident and the style is reminiscent of 19th-century political satire.

artworks.title: C'est dangereux, la pêche à l'épervier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an anthropomorphic octopus entangled with a sign reading "MONARCHIE". The octopus is shown entwined with a curved wooden plank or sign labeled "MONARCHIE". The octopus appears to have its tentacles wrapped around the sign. The background and setting are minimal, focusing attention on the interaction between the octopus and the plank. The drawing style is reminiscent of political cartoons.

artworks.title: Ce que certains journaux appeleraient...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure labeled "France" being led towards a voting box. The image shows a personification of France in a long robe being prodded towards an electoral ballot box labeled "Urne Électorale" by a soldier with a pointed helmet and a weapon. The drawing is monochromatic, using line work and shading to convey the imagery. The text at the bottom reads, "Ce que certains journaux appelleraient une élection libre," translating to "What some newspapers would call a free election." This is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Décidément on ne peut pas...
artworks.description: The image features a cartoonish drawing of two men standing close together. One man is leaning slightly over the other and wearing spectacles, a coat, and tattered pants. The other man has a bushy mustache, wears a military-style helmet and an ornate uniform with epaulets, and is holding a large unfolded sheet of paper. The background is plain, with no additional objects. Text is included above and below the figures in a subtle manner, indicating it is part of a publication.

artworks.title: Histoire d'un règne
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bound figure labeled "France" between two cannons marked "Paris 1851" and "1870 Sedan". The drawing features a central figure tightly bound with ropes, with the word "FRANCE" written above. Flanking the figure on either side are cannon barrels, one labeled "Paris 1851" and the other labeled "1870 Sedan." The drawing uses linework and shading to convey the form and texture of the objects and figure, with the arrangement emphasizing a sense of tension and historical narrative.

artworks.title: La paix a tout prix
artworks.description: This image shows a soldier reaching for a peace offering. The soldier is depicted with a rifle, looking tense and determined. Above the soldier, a hand is holding a branch connected to a peace symbol made of a crown and a globe. The text in the image reinforces the theme of "peace at any price."

artworks.title: Le couronnement de son édifice
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military helmet on top of a small building labeled "CAPITULATION DE SEDAN."

artworks.title: Monsieur sera très bien ici...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing indoors near an open window. The man on the left is standing in profile with his hands behind his back. He wears a dark, cylindrical hat and a long coat. The man on the right faces the viewer and appears to be closing the open window. He has longer hair and wears a coat over a shirt. The background is a shadowy wall and floor, with light streaming in through the window.

artworks.title: Nous ne nous serions jamais douté tout de même...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two sailors in uniforms standing and gesturing toward an emblem on a wall. The sailors, one with a rifle, are engaged in a conversation or contemplation in front of an emblem or signage above them. They appear in traditional naval attire, with flat hats and shoulder adornments. The caption below suggests a humorous or satirical tone. The background implies the setting is a naval vessel or an official building, given the ornamental display. The drawing style resembles a published illustration or a newspaper comic from the 19th century, conveying a narrative through detailing and poses.

artworks.title: Trop étroit pour deux
artworks.description: The image shows two figures seated next to each other on a large plush chair. The figure on the left has a large mustache, expressive eyes, and wears a military uniform. The figure on the right wears a long robe and a crown. They sit on a detailed chair against a plain background with the word "ACTUALITÉS" at the top and the phrase "Trop étroit pour deux" written below.

artworks.title: Vous n'avez pas besoin de me rappeler ses titres...
artworks.description: Two men are depicted in the image. The man on the left is seen from behind, holding a long tool in his right hand. He is wearing a hat, long coat, pants, and shoes. The man on the right has a gaunt face with wavy hair, wearing a loose-fitting shirt and holding a stick. The background shows a rocky or sandy surface, a seascape, and distant rocky formations or cliffs. The image is sketch-like, contained within a border, with writing at the bottom.

artworks.title: Le Corps de Garde
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered in a Middle Eastern setting. The scene depicts various individuals, some seated and some standing, around a large column with worn walls in the background. Different activities are shown, like a person playing a stringed instrument and others conversing. The attire includes robes and turbans. The setting appears to be exterior or semi-exterior, with an overhang to the left. On the ground, there are items like a rifle, a musical instrument, and a shallow round basin that add to the scene. The overall atmosphere suggests a communal space, perhaps a marketplace or gathering place.

artworks.title: Le Corps de Garde
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals in an outdoor setting. The central figure is standing, surrounded by others in various poses. To the left, a person appears to be serving those seated on benches. On the right, people are seated on and around a ledge, with one playing a stringed instrument. Various textiles and hanging items are present, suggesting a lively atmosphere with cultural influences. The drawing is detailed, capturing textures of fabric, architecture, and instruments, depicting everyday life and social interaction.

artworks.title: Un Corps de Garde
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with several figures and objects. The composition shows a busy street-like environment partially covered by a rustic canopy. Multiple figures are depicted engaged in various activities such as sitting, interacting, or holding items typical of the setting. The background features architecture including columns and hanging items, suggesting a traditional, possibly Middle Eastern or North African setting. The use of hatching and intricate line work provides texture to the clothing worn by the figures, shading around the structures, and adds a sense of liveliness and dynamism to the scene.

artworks.title: Alphonse Hirsch
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint on thick wove paper [restrike]
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a full beard and mustache, short swept-back hair, and closed eyes. He is wearing a dark textured garment, and the background is a plain textured surface. The image is in sepia tones, with shading and lines for detail.

artworks.title: Alphonse Hirsch
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the shoulders up. He is slightly turned, with closed eyes or a downward gaze. He has a textured beard, receding short hair, and wears a patterned garment. The image is in a sketch style with cross-hatched lines for detail. The background is plain with an aged paper effect.

artworks.title: Jewish Woman of Algiers  (Juive d'Alger et une rue à Alger)
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on cushions, dressed in traditional attire. The individual is resting on their side with their head supported by their elbow, while their other arm lies across their body. They have dark, wavy hair and a focused expression. The person is wearing a patterned blouse with loose sleeves and flowing bottom wear. There is a textured rug or mat underneath them, surrounded by intricately designed cushions. In the background, there is a textured wall with patterned curtains, and a decorative piece with floral or ornate motifs is partly visible. The setting appears to be a cozy indoor space, possibly a living area. A signature can be seen in the upper-right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Vercingétorix
artworks.description: The image shows a person holding a shield and resting their hand on a sword, standing upright. The person has long hair, a full beard, and wears a crown. They are dressed in armor with a cape draped over their shoulders, leggings, and boots. Various objects are scattered around them, including a detailed helmet, arrows, and a sword. The background depicts a rocky landscape with leafless trees under a cloudy or stormy sky.

artworks.title: Place du Tertre
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated point of view. The horizon displays a row of buildings, with an ornate building facade featuring the word "FABRICE" surrounded by trees with bare branches. The artwork uses detailed etching with fine lines and hatching to depict trees and buildings with texture. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones, creating a vintage atmosphere. In the foreground, there is a paved area with cobblestones, leading towards the trees and structures in the distance.

artworks.title: The Steps of Age (Trap des Ouderdoms)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting various figures at different stages of life arranged on a stair-like structure. The figures are dressed differently, representing different ages. In the foreground is an infant in a cradle, and as the eye moves up, the figures portray advancing age, with the final figure being an elderly person. Text and imagery on the archway and structures suggest the passage of time and life's end. A skull and hourglass are at the base, emphasizing mortality and time. Angels and symbolic elements like a shining sun and orb suggest spiritual themes. The drawing's intricate detailing and use of lines create a narrative progression.

artworks.title: Pastures of Limousin (Pacages du Limousin)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is in the lower half, with the sky meeting a line of distant trees. Large trees with dense foliage dominate the upper right corner. The artwork features fine, detailed strokes creating a textured effect, depicting trees and grass. The colors are monochromatic, various shades of gray. Cattle are seen resting and grazing. Low-lying trees blend into the horizon, and expansive clouds fill the sky.
